存书签

下一章

时笙作为一个常年挖坑不填，太监无数，坑死男女主的后妈型作者，在一个风和日丽，艳阳高照的日子，总算明白了一个道理。

挖坑不填，要遭报应的。

她此时正蹲在一本半人高，外形酷似书的液晶屏面前，心一抽一抽的疼。

前一秒她明明还在和读者吧啦男主被男配掰弯，女主准备去掰直男配，让男主注孤身的狗血剧情，怎么转眼就到了这里？

老子要回去！

【回去的条件我也已经说过了，你还有五秒考虑时间，超过时限，你将被抹杀。】这声音平板冰冷如机制，不含丝毫生机。

时笙：“……”

果然是系统，动不动就抹杀。

好特么的残忍啊！

而此时那书的液晶屏上，已经开始倒数。

5……

4……

3……

“干干干干！”时笙为了小命，立即缴械投诚，丝毫没有骨气可言。

她要回去挖坑……

她要回去写狗血……

她要回去坑死男女主……

嘤嘤嘤，谁让她是后妈呢！

作为一个作者，对系统文简直是不能在熟悉了，她曾经……咳咳，那本文好像太监了。

但是流程她是知道的！

而此时屏幕上的倒数已经不见了，出现两行数据。

姓名：时笙

人品值：-100000

积分：0

“纳尼？这么简单？智力值武力值精神值颜值呢？这和系统文画风不符合啊！还有，我的人品值为什么是-100000？”

看着那一串零，时笙心抽痛得更厉害了，要将这一串鸭蛋全部消灭掉，她才能回去……

她要何时才能回去啊!

Chapter 1 The daughter of a wealthy family (1) - "The villain BOSS is poisonous"

Shi Sheng, as a stepmother-type author who has always dug holes without filling them, had countless eunuchs, and killed the male and female protagonists, finally understood a truth on a sunny day with bright sunshine.

If you dig a hole but don't fill it, you will be punished.

She was currently squatting in front of an LCD screen that was half a person's height and shaped like a book, and her heart was throbbing in pain.

One second ago, she was obviously still having sex with the reader. The male protagonist was broken up by his male partner, and the female protagonist was about to break up with his male partner, leaving the male protagonist to be alone. How come you are here in the blink of an eye?

I want to go back!

[I have already stated the conditions for going back. You have five seconds to think about it. If you exceed the time limit, you will be wiped out.】This sound is as cold as a machine, without any vitality.

Shi Sheng: "..."

As expected, it is the system, which will be wiped out at every turn.

How cruel!

At this time, the countdown had begun on the book's LCD screen.

5…

4…

3…

"Do it, do it!" Shi Sheng immediately surrendered for the sake of his own life, without any backbone at all.

She wants to go back and dig a hole...

She wants to go back and write nonsense...

She wants to go back and trick the male and female protagonists to death...

Hey, who made her the stepmother?

As an author, I am no longer familiar with system articles. She once... ahem, that article seemed like a eunuch.

But she knows the process!

At this time, the countdown on the screen has disappeared, and two lines of data appear.

Name: Shi Sheng

Character value: -100000

Points: 0

"Nani? So simple? What about intelligence, force, spirit, and appearance? This is inconsistent with the style of the system! Also, why is my character value -100,000?"

Looking at the string of zeros, Shi Sheng's heart throbbed even more fiercely. She had to eliminate all the string of duck eggs before she could go back...

When can she go back?
